study type: Observational cohort study with RNA sequencing
outcome: placental transcriptomic signatures (individual gene expression and gene set enrichment analyses)
cohort: The study included 1,029 mother-child pairs from two birth cohorts in Washington state and Memphis, Tennessee.
finding: Higher prenatal stressful life events were associated with altered expression of specific placental genes (ADGRG6, RAB11FIP3, SMYD5), and both prenatal SLEs and maternal CTEs were associated with changes in gene sets related to protein processing, secretion, ubiquitination, ribosome function, epithelial mesenchymal transition, DNA repair, MYC targets, and amino acid pathways.
